currentParagraphText: “Such a charmer,” the vampire goddess smiled. She waved her hand as the painting disappeared, and a gateway appeared on one of the walls. “You can use that to return to your residence, Chosen of the Malefic One. I would love to greet you more appropriately, but seeing as I’ve already delayed you two enough, let us have our official first meeting another time.”
